marker='export async function insertAttachment('
new='''/** Direct lookup includes files on archived issues and avoids issue pagination. */
export async function findAttachmentById(
  orgId: OrgId,
  attachmentId: AttachmentId,
): Promise<IssueAttachment | null> {
  const row = getDb()
    .select()
    .from(attachments)
    .where(
      and(
        orgPredicate(attachments.orgId, orgId),
        eq(attachments.id, attachmentId),
      ),
    )
    .get();
  return row ? toAttachment(row) : null;
}

'''
s=s.replace(marker,new+marker).replace('/** Total stored bytes for one tenant; "'`BillingService` converts to megabytes. */'"','/** Total raw stored bytes for one tenant, without quota rounding. */')

p=Path('src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('  const bytes = db\\n    .select({ value: sql<number | null>"'`sum(${attachments.sizeBytes})` })'"\\n    .from(attachments)\\n    .get();','''  const storage = db

      value: sql<number | null>"'`sum(cast((${attachments.sizeBytes} + ${BYTES_PER_MB} - 1) / ${BYTES_PER_MB} as integer))`,

    .from(attachments)
    .where(eq(attachments.orgId, orgId))
    .get();'"''').replace('storageMbUsed: Math.ceil((bytes?.value ?? 0) / BYTES_PER_MB),','storageMbUsed: storage?.value ?? 0,')
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('usage.projectsUsed > freeLimits.projects\\n','usage.projectsUsed > freeLimits.projects ||\\n        usage.storageMbUsed > freeLimits.storageMb\\n').replace('          projects: usage.projectsUsed,','          projects: usage.projectsUsed,\\n          storageMb: usage.storageMbUsed,')
p.write_text(s)
PY"
